mapper.sql: t.id, t.tenant_id, t.owner_id, t.source_id, t.source_name, t.source_revision, t.branch, t.device_id, t.device_name, t.name, t.request_id, t.revision, a.number AS attempt_number, a.id AS attempt_id, a.state, a.lease_id, COALESCE(a.lease_until <= clock_timestamp(), false) AS expired, a.commit_id, a.archive_sha256, a.file_count, a.archive_bytes, a.message, to_char(t.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS created_at, to_char(a.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') AS updated_at
FROM c2k_task t JOIN c2k_task_attempt a ON a.task_id = t.id AND a.number = t.attempt_number

SELECT
WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND t.device_id = #{deviceId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM c2k_analysis_spec x WHERE x.task_id = t.id) AND a.state IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') ORDER BY t.created_at, t.id LIMIT 100
SELECT FROM c2k_task t JOIN c2k_task_attempt a ON a.task_id = t.id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND t.id = #{id} ORDER BY a.number DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO c2k_task(id, tenant_id, owner_id, source_id, source_name, source_revision, branch, device_id, device_name, name, request_id) VALUES(#{task.id}, #{task.tenantId}, #{task.ownerId}, #{task.sourceId}, #{task.sourceName}, #{task.sourceRevision}, #{task.branch}, #{task.deviceId}, #{task.deviceName}, #{task.name}, #{task.requestId})
INSERT INTO c2k_task_attempt(id, task_id, number, state) VALUES(#{id}, #{taskId}, #{number}, 'QUEUED')
mapper.update: UPDATE c2k_task_attempt SET state = 'RUNNING', lease_id = #{leaseId}, lease_until = clock_timestamp() + interval '45 seconds', message = '设备正在固定本地分支与隔离快照', updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'QUEUED'
UPDATE c2k_task_attempt SET lease_until = clock_timestamp() + interval '45 seconds', updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until > clock_timestamp()

UPDATE c2k_task_attempt SET state = #{state}, message = #{message}, commit_id = #{commitId}, archive_sha256 = #{archiveSha256}, file_count = #{fileCount}, archive_bytes = #{archiveBytes}, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{id} AND state IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') AND (#{state} != 'SUCCEEDED' OR lease_until > clock_timestamp())

UPDATE c2k_task_attempt a SET state = 'EXPIRED', message = '租约已过期；需要手动重试', updated_at = clock_timestamp() FROM c2k_task t WHERE t.id = a.task_id AND t.attempt_number = a.number AND t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND a.state = 'RUNNING' AND a.lease_until <= clock_timestamp()
